messages.subject: Re: Error loading occurrence data
parts:
Hi!

So this should work. When your excel is configured in a different language (this happens to me frequently in spanish for example) when you save as csv it actually separates columns with “;” instead of “,”. You can change this in your excel configuration or just open the file in a text editor and use find and replace to change the delimiter. Your file also had a blank row at the end that was causing issues. 

I hope this solves it, I loaded this attached file and it worked 

best, 

Andrea
